title: Langar, Growth, and the Return of Mughal Pressure

blocks.text: The page first remembers a more integrated Panth order in which sabh k6 ik than langar karvavai and common provisioning held the community together across status and faction.
It then notes how quickly the Panth could still grow under discipline, since nit parti panth yaun vadhtç jahi captures the sense of steady expansion even after repeated hardship.

That growth is interrupted once more when jab bandô turkan bandhiô and the Mughals reverse course, but singhan un kó dagó na khâyô; instead tau singh khind ban luk gaç, and the story pivots back toward the next Kapoor Singh sequence.
